newsitem.title: UK: Bibby hopeful despite stg profit squeeze.
newsitem.headline: Bibby hopeful despite stg profit squeeze.

text.p: British diversified industrials and trading group J. Bibby and Sons Plc said on Wednesday that its operating profitability was being squeezed downwards by the effect of currency translations into a strengthening sterling, but it nevertheless expected the group to show progress over the full-year.

The company made the comments in an update on trading in the three months to December 28, 1996, which showed pretax profits rising by 6.9 percent to 9.3 million stg but operating profits slipping back to 10.6 million stg from 11.2 million.

"The operating profit would, however, have shown a slight improvement, but for the strength of sterling which adversely affected the translation of profits earning in foreign currencies," the Bibby statement added.

Chairman Richard Mansell-Jones explained that, "with about two thirds of the group's turnover arising overseas, the rate of growth in profitability will inevitably be constrained if sterling continues to be strong."
"Nevertheless, I expect the group to show progress over last year," he added.
